stem.text: A light rigid rod XY has an object of weight $W$ fixed at one end. The rod is in equilibrium, resting on a roller at Z and a vertical wall at X. The roller exerts a force $R$ on the rod as shown. The diagram shows the directions, but not the magnitudes, of the forces $R$ and $W$.

stem.alt: Rod XY with its lower end X against a vertical hatched wall on the left; roller at Z on the rod; force R at Z pointing up and to the left, perpendicular to the rod; object at end Y with a downward force W

stem.text: What is the direction of the force on the rod at X?

A.alt: Arrow pointing up and to the right

B.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the left

D.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the right
